stem.text: Which statement about oxygen combining with haemoglobin is correct?

A.text: All oxygen molecules which combine stop the haemoglobin molecule changing shape.

B.text: Four oxygen molecules can combine with each haem group.

C.text: The first oxygen molecule to combine does not affect the shape of haemoglobin.

D.text: The second oxygen molecule to combine makes it easier for the third to combine.
